services.name: Oct. Session: Conservatory Acting
services.desc: Conservatory Acting is a space for working actors to hone their craft and keep their skills sharp. Bring in scenes or monologues you want to work on and you’ll have the opportunity to work with prominent Seattle actors, directors, and teaching artists and receive individualized feedback. Experience Level: This class is intended for actors at the intermediate level or above. Teachers will assume that students have some previous acting experience and have some foundational knowledge, such as textual analysis skills.
